column1: # CodeBrix.LilyPort -- THE D43 PORT-GENERATED BASELINE (ruling R9, Jeremy, 2026-08-16).
# WHAT THIS IS.  Six regression pages whose ONLY divergence from the oracle is the
# glyph-outline skyline debug drawing, frozen from the port's own output and graded
# against the port's own output thereafter:
#     python3 compare-output.py --baseline baseline/svg candidate/svg
# Expect 6 of 6 MATCH.  --baseline is load-bearing and is not a convenience: without
# it the baseline side resolves its glyph paths against the ORACLE's half of
# glyph-identity.tsv, 5 of 73 resolve, and all six rows read GLYPHS-DIFFER.  That is
# the control, and it was run.
# WHAT IT CLAIMS -- NO DRIFT, AND NOTHING ELSE.  Rule 33 forbids an expected value
# recorded from the port's own output, and this is exactly that, so it must never be
# read as a correctness result.  The CORRECTNESS claim for this mechanism is carried
# by GlyphOutlineSkylineTests in the Engine suite, whose expected segment counts are
# computed from upstream's own max (2, chord / 0.2) with a scale control that a table
# returning a constant cannot fake.  LANDING THE BASELINE WITHOUT THAT FENCE IS THE
# FAILURE MODE; the two are not interchangeable.
# WHY THESE SIX CANNOT BE GRADED AGAINST THE ORACLE.  The port BUILDS Emmentaler from
# the Metafont sources on purpose (D13/D23's neighbour, tools/font-build/).  That
# build is not outline-identical to the oracle's: MEASURED from the committed
# glyph-identity index on 2026-08-16, 277 of emmentaler-20's 662 glyph outlines
# serialize identically between the two builds and 385 do not.  Every glyph DIMENSION
# is read from the LILC table, which IS byte-identical -- which is why 2,208 rows
# match and only the one mechanism that reads the OUTLINE does not.  Re-measured the
# same day: accidentals.sharp, whose outline is IDENTICAL between the builds, is the
# control and its skyline already agrees with the oracle exactly; clefs.G and
# noteheads.s2 differ.  The divergence is confined to glyphs whose outlines differ.
# Full account: Engine PORT-COVERAGE, "GLYPH-OUTLINE SKYLINES DIFFER BECAUSE THE TWO
# EMMENTALER BUILDS DIFFER".
# /!\ RE-FREEZING.  Only from a FRESH full sweep, never from whatever candidate/svg
# happens to be on disk, and only with a recorded reason -- a baseline re-frozen to
# make a red row green has destroyed the only thing it was for.  These six rows STILL
# grade GLYPHS-DIFFER against the oracle corpus in the ordinary sweep, and still floor
# there; being graded here is a statement about G1, not about the measurement.
# /!\ NOT THE G1 SKIP LIST.  Nothing here is skipped.  g1-skip-list.tsv holds the eight
# rows ruled OUT of G1 (R8(A)/D31); these six are ruled IN and graded, against this.
